Type: sofa
Name: Strathwood Falkner Sectional Left Arm Loveseat with Cushions
Materials: Aluminum
Comfortable, cushioned, sectional loveseat with left arm for outdoor use Frame made of durable yet lightweight cast aluminum with black powder-coat finish; 100-percent Olefin cushion covers Align with Falkner's Right Arm Loveseat and Sectional Corner Lounge as a complete set; no assembly required; imported Each seat cushion measures 29.3 by 29.5 by 4 inches; each back cushion measures 19.1 by 29.3 by 4 inches Loveseat measures 32-1/2 inches high by 34-3/4 inches deep by 57-1/2 inches wide; weighs 38.6 pounds
